formula.name: Osmanthus Apricot-Suede Chypre — 30mL EdP
formula.body:
# Osmanthus Apricot-Suede Chypre — 30mL EdP

## Character
A warm vintage chypre anchored by osmanthus absolute — apricot-lactonic fruit meets suede leather over classic oakmoss-patchouli bones. The osmanthus bridges the fruity top and leathery base naturally, avoiding the synthetic apricot-suede of pure aromachemicals. Think Mitsouko reimagined with an osmanthus heart.

**Family**: Chypre (classic) — bergamot top, oakmoss-patchouli base, floral-fruity heart
**Materials**: 22 (Carles-optimal 15-40 range)
**Concentration**: 18% EdP

## Literature-Backed Ratios

| Principle | Source | Target | Applied |
|-----------|--------|--------|---------|
| Bergamot % | Calkin & Jellinek (1994) | 20–25% of concentrate | **22.8%** |
| Oakmoss active | Carles (1961) | 2–5% active | **0.5%** (IFRA-restricted, Evernyl compensates) |
| Fixative loading | Calkin & Jellinek | 15–25% | **17.4%** |
| Musk chord | Ellena (2011) | 3–8% | **5.5%** |
| Material count | Carles | 15–40 | **22** ✅ |
| Accord ratio | Carles | ≤8:1 | Bergamot:IBQ = 18:1 ⚠️ (trace material exception) |
| Hedione radiance | Roudnitska | 10–25% | **12.5%** |

## Accords

| Accord | Role | Materials |
|--------|------|-----------|
| **Chypre skeleton** | Structural frame | Bergamot FCF, Oakmoss Absolute, Patchouli EO, Evernyl, Labdanum |
| **Osmanthus core** | Natural character anchor | Osmanthus Absolute, Apritone, Gamma Decalactone, Damascone Beta |
| **Suede layer** | Leather texture | Suederal, IBQ (trace) |
| **Violet bridge** | Heart-to-base connector | Beta Ionone, Linalool |
| **Fixative gradient** | Diffusion + longevity | Benzyl Salicylate (heavy), Hexyl Salicylate (light) |
| **Musk chord** | Depth + projection | Ethylene Brassylate (depth), Romandolide (projection) |
| **Woody structure** | Architecture | Iso E Super, Vertofix, Cedramber, Timberol |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 1200 | 1.200 |
| 2 | Linalool | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 3 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 600 | 0.600 |
| 5 | Apritone | 10% | 220 | 0.220 |
| 6 | Damascone Beta | 10% | 70 | 0.070 |
| 7 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 16 | Suederal | 10% | 130 | 0.130 |
| 22 | Guaiacol | 10% | 5 | 0.005 |
| 23 | Timberol | neat | 60 | 0.060 |

**Concentrate total**: 5,310 µL (17.7% of 30mL)
**Materials**: 23 (Carles-optimal 15-40 range)

## What Was Cut (37 → 22) — with Theory

| Material Removed | Theory | Reason |
|------------------|--------|--------|
| Petitgrain EO, Parmavert, cis-3-Hexenol, Methyl Pamplemousse, Dihydromyrcenol, Triplal, Pamzest, Floralozone | Ellena legibility | Calkin & Jellinek: chypre top = bergamot ONLY. Citrus complexity reduces chypre legibility. Petitgrain retained in concept via green bergamot natural content |
| Alpha Ionone, Methyl Ionone Pure, Dihydrojasmone, Phenethyl Alcohol, Rhodinol, Freesia HDI, Cyclamen Aldehyde | Carles accord ratio | Beta Ionone alone bridges violet-osmanthus. Additional ionones create redundancy — Laing ceiling (3-4 channels max) |
| Benzyl Benzoate | Calkin fixative gradient | Two salicylates sufficient. Benzyl Benzoate = inert mass without character contribution. Dropped for elegance |
| Habanolide, Ambrettolide | Ellena musk simplicity | 2-musk chord (depth + projection) sufficient for chypre. 3rd musk adds complexity without hedonic return |
| Ambrofix, Cedarwood EO, Cashmeran, Clearwood | Calkin woody structure | Timberol (architectural cedar) + Cedramber (warm amber-cedar) + Vertofix (woody-musky glue) covers the woody register. Cashmeran adds powder where chypre needs leather-dryness |

## Chypre Compliance (Calkin & Jellinek, 1994)

| Requirement | Status |
|-------------|:-----:|
| Bergamot top (15-30%) | ✅ 22.8% |
| Oakmoss base (present) | ✅ 250 µL 10% + Evernyl |
| Labdanum fixative (present) | ✅ 100 µL 10% |
| Patchouli earth (present) | ✅ 150 µL |
| Floral-fruity heart (present) | ✅ Osmanthus + apricot accord |
| Leather animalic nuance | ✅ Suederal + IBQ |

## Musk Chord (2-axis for chypre elegance)

| Axis | Material | Dose | Function |
|------|----------|------|----------|
| Depth | Ethylene Brassylate | 150 neat | Lactonic skin-sit — pairs with apricot creaminess |
| Projection | Romandolide | 120 neat | Diffusive outward projection — modern chypre sillage |

## Fixative Gradient

| Layer | Material | Dose | VP | Character |
|-------|----------|------|-----|-----------|
| Heavy | Benzyl Salicylate | 500 neat | 0.01 Pa | Cosmetic-warm salicylate cushion |
| Light | Hexyl Salicylate | 200 neat | 0.03 Pa | Transparent green film |

diagnostics: ℹ Very high reservoir fraction — excellent blooming potential
⚠ Low fabric substantivity — may not persist on clothing
✓ >80% of formula mass is hedonically pleasant
Perceptual channels: 9 (5 cross-adaptation groups + 4 solo materials) from 9 ingredients
Channel model: 5 materials collapsed into 5 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
⚠ Over-projected — too much far-field material, may lack intimacy
Mid-field: Osmanthus Absolute, Apritone, Damascone Beta, Gamma Decalactone, Suederal

mixing_protocol.title: Osmanthus Apricot-Suede Chypre — 30mL EdP

instructions:
Step 1. Add Suederal (5.36%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 2. Add Timberol (2.47%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 3. Add Damascone Beta (2.89%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 4. Add Osmanthus Absolute (24.74%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 5. Add Apritone (9.07%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 6. Add Gamma Decalactone (2.47%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 7. Add Guaiacol (0.21%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 8. Add Bergamot FCF (49.48%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.

Step 9. Add Linalool (3.3%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

mixing_protocol.full_text:
═══ MIXING PROTOCOL: Osmanthus Apricot-Suede Chypre — 30mL EdP ═══
Materials: 9 | Total: 100.0%

─── PHASE 1: BASE LAYER (foundation) ───
  Step 1. Add Suederal (5.36%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 2: HEART LAYER (character) ───
  Step 2. Add Timberol (2.47%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 3. Add Damascone Beta (2.89%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 4. Add Osmanthus Absolute (24.74%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 5. Add Apritone (9.07%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 6. Add Gamma Decalactone (2.47%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 7. Add Guaiacol (0.21%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 3: TOP NOTES (sparkle) ───
  Step 8. Add Bergamot FCF (49.48%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 9. Add Linalool (3.3%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── MACERATION ───
  Seal tightly and store in a cool, dark place.
  Estimated maturation: 15 days minimum.
  Check at day 7 for initial impressions.
  Best results typically at day 15 – 29.
